classification.difficultyReason: Multiply by a given scale factor to find the image sides. In part b the student must also match the unlabelled image sides to the original sides using the angle marks.

answer.short: Vertical side: $6\text{ cm}$; horizontal side: $4.5\text{ cm}$; sloping side: $7.5\text{ cm}$.
answer.worked:
Match corresponding sides using the equal angles.
$\begin{aligned}\text{Vertical side (between }90^\circ\text{ and }37^\circ)&=12\times0.5\\&=6\text{ cm}\\\text{Horizontal side (between }90^\circ\text{ and }53^\circ)&=9\times0.5\\&=4.5\text{ cm}\\\text{Sloping side}&=15\times0.5\\&=7.5\text{ cm}\end{aligned}$
